definitions.explanation: A predatory insect with a triangular head, large compound eyes, and distinctive forelegs adapted for grasping prey. Known for their "praying" posture when resting.

examples.japanese: カマキリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鎌|かま}→鎌：16402_kama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ような→よう：01114_you⟧⟦{前足|まえあし}→前足：29904_maeashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえた→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧。
examples.english: The praying mantis caught its prey with its sickle-like front legs.

examples.japanese: カマキリ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{益虫|えきちゅう}→益虫：17787_ekichuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Praying mantises are beneficial insects that eat pests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧カマキリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: You can find praying mantis egg cases in autumn.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: The name カマキリ comes from ⟦{鎌|かま}→鎌：16402_kama⟧ (sickle) + ⟦{切|き}り→切り：noentry⟧ (cutting), referring to their scythe-like forelegs. Also written as ⟦{蟷螂|かまきり}→蟷螂：noentry⟧ or ⟦{鎌切|かまきり}→鎌切：noentry⟧.

TYPES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦オオカマキリ→オオカマキリ：noentry⟧ (large mantis - most common)
- ⟦チョウセンカマキリ→チョウセンカマキリ：noentry⟧ (Korean mantis)
- ⟦ハラビロカマキリ→ハラビロカマキリ：noentry⟧ (wide-abdomen mantis)
- ⟦コカマキリ→コカマキリ：noentry⟧ (small mantis)

BEHAVIOR:
- ⟦{擬態|ぎたい}→擬態：29905_gitai⟧ (camouflage) - can blend with leaves and plants
- ⟦{共食|ともぐ}い→共食い：18756_tomogui⟧ (cannibalism) - females sometimes eat males after mating
- ⟦{卵鞘|らんしょう}→卵鞘：noentry⟧ (egg case/ootheca) - foam-like structure protecting eggs

CULTURAL NOTE: Children in Japan often keep カマキリ as temporary pets in summer. The ⟦{卵鞘|らんしょう}→卵鞘：noentry⟧ (egg case) found in autumn is said to predict winter snow depth in folk beliefs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カマキリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep a praying mantis)
- カマキリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (praying mantis eggs)
